LABORATORY REMARKS & CLINICAL INTERPRETATION
1. Mild Microcytic/Normocytic Anemia: Hemoglobin (10.8 g/dL) and Hematocrit (32.4%) are mildly reduced. Suggestive of early iron
deficiency anemia or anemia of chronic disease. Serum Ferritin, Iron, and TIBC studies are recommended for clinical correlation.
2. Mild Leukocytosis with Neutrophilia: Elevated Total WBC (12.45 x10 3/uL) with relative and absolute neutrophilia (73.5%, 9.15
x1043/uL) is observed. This hematological profile is commonly associated with an acute inflammatory state, mild localized infection; or
physical stress. No immature granulocytes or blasts identified on blood smear examination.
